question: What Comes with My UNO?
answer: UNO includes an illuminated 1 L reservoir, battery, charger, reusable capsule and accessories. PRO: tinted reservoir; GOLD: transparent. A trial set of disposable self-fill capsules (a few pieces) — included free of charge. See Product information for the full set and options.
extendedAnswer: Your set includes UNO (polycarbonate + ABS body), an illuminated 1 L food-grade polycarbonate reservoir, one UNO-FX05 battery, charger, reusable self-fill capsule, hose, mouthpiece, connector, brushes, tweezers, spare ceramic bowl, five spare membrane valves, instructions and branded packaging. A trial set of disposable self-fill capsules (a few pieces) — included free of charge. PRO: carbon-fibre handle with a Tritan mouthpiece, black hose, tinted illuminated reservoir. GOLD: titanium mouthpiece, 24K gold-plated, white hose, transparent illuminated reservoir. Optional accessories — USD reference only; AED price on request: extra battery $120; Pro capsule with four zones $40; separate charger $75; ceramic bowl $30; disposable self-fill capsules — packs of 20, 50 or 100: $30 / $50 / $80; hose, mouthpiece and connector set — PRO $100 / GOLD $200. Accessories are paid in full with your initial payment; the final payment stays the same.

question: What makes a RAMSIDER Pro capsule different?
answer: RAMSIDER filled capsules contain blends based on tea leaf, tobacco leaf or herbs. Each blend is linked to its temperature program. Scan the QR label with your phone, remove both labels and insert the capsule. The program adapts heating to the blend to support consistent flavour.
